readerCopy.body: A situation can change quickly once the person expected to stay quiet realizes that the balance of power is no longer the same. When Pluto trines Lilith, leverage and autonomy reinforce each other, making a hidden rule, unequal arrangement, private consequence, or source of control easier to name. Information can alter who has choices once the old terms are explicit. The advantage works best when it changes the agreement rather than reproducing the controlling behavior that made the change necessary.
